task_completion.description: The agent successfully loads the chest CT volume into the medical imaging software (e.g., 3D Slicer).
task_completion.visual_evidence: A CT scan of the chest is visible in the axial, sagittal, and coronal viewports of the application.

task_completion.description: The agent navigates to the axial slice where the main pulmonary artery bifurcates.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The axial view shows the main pulmonary artery splitting into left and right branches, adjacent to the ascending aorta.

task_completion.description: The agent places a measurement ruler or markup line across the main pulmonary artery.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A measurement line is visible across the PA in the axial view, with a label or property panel showing a value near 31.0 mm.

task_completion.description: The agent places a measurement ruler or markup line across the ascending aorta at the same level.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A measurement line is visible across the ascending aorta in the axial view, with a label or property panel showing a value near 32.0 mm.

task_completion.description: The agent saves the PA and aorta markups to the specified JSON file paths.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent interacts with a 'Save' dialog or executes a save command, and the file browser or terminal shows the creation of pa_measurement.mrk.json and aorta_measurement.mrk.json in the target directory.

task_completion.description: The agent calculates the ratio and saves the final JSON report with all required fields.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal output shows pa_aorta_report.json containing pa_diameter_mm (~31), aorta_diameter_mm (~32), pa_aorta_ratio (~0.97), and an assessment (e.g., 'normal').

integrity.description: The agent used the medical imaging software GUI to perform measurements rather than just writing files via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with measurement tools, rulers, or markup modules within the 3D Slicer interface.

integrity.description: The measurement values in the report are derived from the actual tool placement in the GUI, not just hardcoded from privileged info.
integrity.visual_evidence: The measurement lines in the viewport physically span the diameter of the vessels and the on-screen 'Length' value matches the report.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply copy a pre-existing report file from another directory.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen manually typing the report values or using a script/tool that processes the active session's data.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The synthetic CT volume has a ground truth PA diameter of 31.0 mm and an ascending aorta diameter of 32.0 mm. The resulting PA:Aorta ratio is approximately 0.97. Since the ratio is <= 1.0, the assessment should be classified as 'normal' or 'within normal limits'.
